title.en: An Act Authorizing the Governor-General of the Philippine Islands to Enter Into An Agreement With the Atlantic, Gulf & Pacific Company of Manila Whereby Said Company May Reclaim a Certain Portion of the Foreshore of Manila Bay, and for Other

text.en:
The Governor-General is hereby authorized and empowered to enter into an agreement on behalf
of the Government of the Philippine Islands with the Atlantic, Gulf & Pacific Company of Manila, a
corporation duly organized and doing business under the laws of the Philippine Islands, whereby the said
corporation shall be authorized, under the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth, to reclaim that portion of
the foreshore of Manila Bay described as follows:
Starting at Corner No. 8 in Lot No. 2, Block No. 1801, property of the Atlantic, Gulf & Pacific Company of
Manila, at Muelle de la Industria, Manila, Philippine Islands, and extending into Manila Bay due North for 10
meters to new- Corner
Thence N. 88° 48' W. for 287.64 meters to New Corner No. 2.
Thence due South for 118 meters to New Corner No. 3.
Thence due West for 200 meters to New Corner No. 4.
Thence due South for 118 meters to New Corner No. 5.
Thence N. 88° 55' E., 228.20 meters back to the present
lighthouse or Corner 1, Lot 1, Block 1801.
Thence N. 62° 26' W. for 8.69 meters to Corner No. 2,
Thence N. 51° 47' E. for 8.73 meters to Corner No. 3,
Thence N. 83° 56' E. for 2.55 meters to Corner No. 4,
Thence N. 84° 04' E. for 19.16 meters to Corner No, 5,
Thence N. 84° 02' E. for 27.23 meters to Corner No. 6,
Thence N. 13° 46' E. for 28.84 meters to Corner No. 7,

Thence N. 30° 30' E. for 56.54 meters to Corner No. 8,
Thence due North for 16.94 meters to Corner No. 9,
Thence S. 79° 03' E. for 22.69 meters to Corner No. 10,
Thence N. 81° 07' E. for 68.44 meters to Corner No. 11,
Thence S. 35° 49' E. for 16.66 meters to Corner No. 12,
Thence N. 88° 47' E. for 0.47 meters to Corner No. 6,
Thence N. 0° 51' W. for 116.37 meters to Corner No. 7,
Thence S. 88° 48' E. for 77.64 meters to Starting Corner No. 8,
Lot No. 2, Block No. 1801, with a total area of approximately 59,000 square meters.
